Overview

Manchester is a city in England with a population of 568,996. A vibrant northern hub known for its music scene, football culture, and booming tech sector with relatively affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 142 sunny days a year.
